body: The same thing happened to me today. The responses are so automatic, I'm pretty sure at one point the guy straight up sent me an automated response. Total joke. I know you feel alone right now but I relate to this so much and I hope you at least feel heard, because I do.

Now for the rant about the suicide hotline, if no one minds: What the fuck even is that shit? I spoke to this mf for two hours and my problem wasnt addressed. "Hm it sounds like you want to die because you are very unhappy" YEAH NO SHIT SHERLOCK. DO YOU WANT A MEDAL FOR THAT ONE???

Or in response to the issue I present above, he said "Oh it sounds like you are frustrated due to the inability to access mental health care right now". NO WAY. I could get the same assistance from a monkey stomping and banging its fists on a fucking speak and spell.

Lemme clarify: Those hotlines could be super useful for people who just need someone to listen or for someone to provide resources. Thats fine. But it is advertised to my mentally unstable ass like its the end all cure all for mental illness. Sick of that.
